summary: Full Section N (Post-Sales) coverage on Laravel 11 CRM. 12/12 new Section N pytest tests + 65/65 regression (Phase A/B/L/M) tests pass = 77/77. Frontend Post-Sales tab, record-payment modal, receipt rendering, document checklist, welcome letter, verify/match/discrepancy/received/verified buttons all wired and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentService::receiptNo() uses COUNT+1 across the whole year without a transaction — under concurrent inserts this can produce duplicate receipt_no. Consider a DB unique constraint + retry, or an atomic counters table.
Same race condition exists in PostSalesService::serial() for letter serial numbers (WEL-YYYY-NNNN).

PostSalesController::show() auto-seeds a checklist for confirmed bookings on every GET — cheap because seedChecklist is idempotent, but it does perform an extra existence query per request. Fine for MVP.

Booking is left in 'form_sent' status after markWon (deal_value/token_amount posted); UI/API relies on downstream /verify then /pay-token to progress to 'verified' and 'confirmed'. Documented in tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, modal + rows + verify/match/discrepancy + doc buttons + welcome letter all rendered)

test_credentials: admin@crm.local/Admin@12345, cs@crm.local/Demo@12345 (Post-Sales/CS role), rahul@crm.local/Demo@12345 (Sales Exec, no postsales.manage)
seed_data_creation: Ran `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force` before backend regression run. Section N tests create their own fresh leads/bookings each run using UUID-based unique phones/emails (name prefix TEST_N_ / FE_N_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Laravel API at http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1. Use `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force` before running the full pytest suite to ensure the /tasks pagination doesn't hide seeded tasks. Section N tests are self-contained. Frontend SPA uses hash routes (#/leads/{id}); auth token is read from localStorage. The recorded FE flow: admin login → POST /leads → POST /leads/{id}/won → POST /bookings/{bid}/verify → POST /bookings/{bid}/pay-token → open #/leads/{id} → click tab-postsales.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Two minor script issues fixed during testing: (1) time-based phone generation collided under xdist parallelism → switched to UUID-based unique phone; (2) initial expectation that PUT /leads/{id} would be blocked after 'won' was wrong (lock is a flag exposed on the model, not an update guard) → changed regression assertion to verify lead.locked=true and lead.status='won'.
